research.title: Occlusion Sensitivity in Visual Object Tracking
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing existing tracking models under partial occlusion, varying occluder placement while holding target motion and image resolution constant.
Analyzed tracking failures by occlusion duration and target appearance, distinguishing localization drift from failures to recover after objects reappeared.

research.title: Robustness and Calibration of Semantic Segmentation Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating existing semantic segmentation models under blur, noise, and illumination changes, controlling training data and corruption severity across comparisons.
Analyzed classwise segmentation errors and confidence calibration, using boundary regions and object size strata to characterize where predictive reliability deteriorated.

publications.title: Classwise Error Patterns in Semantic Segmentation Under Controlled Image Corruptions
Confidence Calibration at Object Boundaries Under Corruption Shift in Semantic Segmentation

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Features for Image Matching
bullets: Implemented an image matching pipeline using established local descriptors, nearest neighbor matching, and robust homography estimation for overlapping image pairs.
Compared descriptor configurations under viewpoint and illumination changes, examining match precision, geometric consistency, and failure cases involving repetitive textures.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine tuning of pretrained convolutional networks for fine-grained classification using consistent training and validation splits.
Compared adaptation strategies through per-class recall and confusion analysis, examining visually similar categories and sensitivity to training augmentation choices.
